content.message: This intentionally long message verifies wrapping, selection, and the card's fixed 9px transparent shadow inset. It describes several operations so the message occupies multiple lines at ordinary desktop widths. The action area must remain reachable and the visual edge must stay consistent on every side of the WebView.
